eligibility_authority: Brian manuscript five criteria and seven labels; latest direct author adjudications
identity_policy: Merge corroborated duplicate indexing; retain distinct DOI/issue republications, recurring notices and records lacking sufficient evidence for merger. Repetition of a trial across conference years is retained.
interval_scope: Wilson intervals describe identified-report proportions, not screening-error or overall sensitivity uncertainty.
outputs_certification: Operational cleaning, recorded human decisions and internal arithmetic reconciled; not a claim of exhaustive external bibliographic or full-text eligibility validation.
